attchmntText: Sanwaria Consumer Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sanwaria Limited, under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, announced the outcome of its suspended Board meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board approved the Standalone and Consolidated Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company also approved the Auditor Limited Review Report issued by Statutory Auditors on these results. The meeting commenced at 04.48 p.m. and concluded at 5:12 p.m. The financial results will be uploaded on the company's website in compliance with Regulation 33 of SEBI regulations. The announcement was addressed to the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange of India.

attchmntText: Sanwaria Consumer Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
desc: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
